en: The image depicts an interior room filled with stacks of intricately patterned rugs. Three people are shown: a man in a dress shirt and tie, a child, and a man in more traditional attire. They are holding up a large rug with geometric Native American designs. More rugs with similar patterns are draped in the background, and the walls appear to be adobe. There is white text at the bottom right identifying the location and individuals.
